﴿وقطناهم اثنتى عشرة أسباطا أمما﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and قطعناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). اثنتى عشرة is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of قطعناهم, i.e. «We divided them, numbered by this number»; or قطعناهم is in the sense of «We made them», so that اثنتى عشرة is a second direct object. أسباطًا is a badal (substitute) of اثنتى عشرة, and أممًا is a badal of ﴿أسباطًا﴾, so it is a badal of the badal. [Translator's note: the heading in the source reads «وقطناهم», a misprint for ﴿وقطعناهم﴾.]
﴿وأوحينا إلى موسى إذ استسقاه قومه﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قطعناهم. إلى موسى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحينا, and ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, also attached to أوحينا. استسقاه قومه: a verb, a direct object and an agent; the clause ﴿استسقاه قومه﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿أن اضرب بعصاك الحجر﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters; the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdarī, and together with what it enters upon it is, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the [implied] preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; the clause ﴿اضرب﴾ is then the ṣila of the maṣdarī ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. اضرب: an imperative verb, and the agent is latent (mustatir). بعصاك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اضرب﴾. الحجر: the direct object.
﴿فانبجست منه اثنتا عشرة عينا﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انبجست, اثنتا عشرة is the agent of انبجست, and عينًا is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿قد علم كل أناس مشربهم﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), and علم كل أناس is a verb and its agent; أناس is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is a collective noun (ism jamʿ) whose singular is إنسان – it is also said to be a broken plural of it. مشربهم is the direct object.
﴿وظللنا عليهم الغمام وأنزلنا عليهم المن والسلوى﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ظللنا is a verb and its agent; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ظللنا, and الغمام is the direct object. أنزلنا is conjoined to ظللنا, عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزلنا, المن is the direct object, and السلوى is conjoined to المن.
﴿كلوا من طيبات ما رزقناكم﴾: The clause كلوا is in the accusative position as the object of an omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. «and We said». كلوا is an imperative verb, and the واو is the agent; من طيبات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كلوا, and ما is a relative noun in the genitive position by annexation to طيبات. The clause رزقناكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وما ظلمونا ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: The واو is resumptive, ما is negating, and ظلمونا is a verb, its agent and its direct object. The واو is circumstantial, and لكن is inoperative and lightened. كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and the واو is its noun; أنفسهم is a fronted object of يظلمون, and the clause يظلمون is in the accusative position as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. The clause ﴿وما ظلمونا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:161-161.t:
﴿وإذ قيل لهم اسكنوا هذه القرية﴾: The واو is resumptive, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «remember». The clause ﴿قيل﴾ is in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل. The clause اسكنوا is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), هذه is a demonstrative in the accusative position as a direct object by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), and القرية is a badal (substitute).
﴿وكلوا منها حيث شئتم﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and كلوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اسكنوا; منها, the preposition and its genitive noun, are attached to كلوا. حيث is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «moving about»; شئتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the genitive position by the adverb's annexation to it.
﴿وقولوا﴾: Conjoined to وكلوا.
﴿حطة﴾: The khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «our request is relief» or «our matter is relief»; the nominal clause is the object of the saying. Its basic form would be the accusative, because its meaning is «relieve us of our sins», but it was turned to the nominative to indicate the permanence of the relief and constancy in it.
﴿وادخلوا﴾: An imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the واو is the agent; the clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying.
﴿الباب﴾: The direct object.
﴿سجدًا﴾: A ḥāl.
﴿نغفر﴾: An imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command.
﴿لكم﴾: The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نغفر.
﴿خطيئاتكم﴾: The direct object.
﴿سنزيد المحسنين﴾: An imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a direct object.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿قال يا قوم ليس بي ضلالة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; ﴿ليس﴾ is a defective past verb; بي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of ليس; and ضلالة is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿ولكني رسول من رب العالمين﴾: the و is a conjunction; لكن is an abrogating particle, and the ياء is its noun; رسول is the khabar of لكن; and من رب العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:162-162.t:
﴿فبدل الذين ظلموا منهم قولا غير الذي قيل لهم﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and بدل الذين is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). There is an omission in the speech: what is omitted is the second object of بدّل, its implied form being «with that which was said to them». قولا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), غير is an adjective (naʿt), الذي is a relative noun in the genitive position by annexation, and the clause قيل لهم is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأرسلنا عليهم رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يظلمون﴾: فأرسلنا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فبدّل, and عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective. بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أرسلنا; the باء is causal, and ما is a relative noun or maṣdarī. كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and the clause يظلمون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿أبلغكم رسالات ربي وأنصح لكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, or the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of رسول; the كاف is the first object of أبلغكم, and رسالات ربي is the second object; and أنصح لكم is conjoined to أبلغكم.
﴿وأعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون﴾: conjoined to أبلغكم; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم, and an omitted (word) must be supplied, i.e.: "from His direction"; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause لا تعلمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:163-163.t:
﴿واسألهم عن القرية التي كانت حاضرة البحر﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and اسألهم is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). عن القرية is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اسألهم, and التي is a relative noun, an adjective (naʿt) of القرية. The clause كانت has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the noun of كانت is latent, i.e. «هي», and حاضرة البحر is the khabar (predicate) of كانت.
﴿إذ يعدون في السبت﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the genitive position as a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from ﴿القرية﴾, what is meant by the town being its people; or it is an adverb of past time attached to ﴿حاضرة﴾. يعدون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿يعدون﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿إذ تأتيهم حيتانهم يوم سبتهم شرعا ويوم لا يسبتون لا تأتيهم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يعدون﴾, and the clause ﴿تأتيهم﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation; حيتانهم is the agent of تأتيهم, and شرعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of حيتانهم. يوم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to إذ, and the clause ﴿لا يسبتون﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿كذلك نبلوهم بما كانوا يفسقون﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the accusative position as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being «with a trial like that trial We try them». ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address. ﴿نبلوهم﴾ is an imperfect verb, its agent is latent, its implied form being «نحن», the هاء is the direct object, and the ميم is the sign of the plural. ﴿بما﴾: the باء is causal, and ما is maṣdarī, i.e. «We try them because of their transgression»; the clause ﴿يفسقون﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿أوعجبتم أن جاءكم ذكر من ربكم على رجل منكم﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the و is a conjunction; عجبتم is conjoined to an omitted (clause) that must be supplied, i.e.: "Did you deny and wonder?"; أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, and together with what it governs it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: "at the fact that there came to you"; ذكر is the fāʿil (agent); من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ذكر, or attached to جاءكم; على رجل is a naʿt of ذكر, and an omitted (word) must be supplied, i.e.: "on the tongue of a man"; and منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of رجل.
﴿لينذركم ولتتقوا ولعلكم ترحمون﴾: the لام gives the reason for the coming; ينذركم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جاءكم; لتتقوا is conjoined to لينذركم; the clause of hope is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ترحمون is the khabar (predicate) of لعل.

muyesser-irab:164-164.t:
﴿وإذ قالت أمة منهم﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding ﴿إذ﴾ in the saying of Allah the Exalted ﴿إذ يعدون﴾. The clause ﴿قالت﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation, أمة is the fāʿil (agent), and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of أمة.
﴿لم تعظون قوما الله مهلكهم أو معذبهم عذابا شديدا﴾: The لام is a preposition, and the interrogative ما has had its alif dropped because the preposition enters upon it; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تعظون. قومًا is the object of تعظون. الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and مهلكهم a khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is an adjective of ﴿قومًا﴾. أو is a conjunction, and معذبهم is conjoined to مهلكهم. عذابا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), and شديدًا is an adjective.
﴿قالوا معذرة إلى ربكم ولعلهم يتقون﴾: The clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position. معذرة is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. «we admonished them for the sake of an excuse»; or it is in the accusative as a maṣdar by an implied verb from its own root, i.e. «we make an excuse»; or it is in the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). إلى ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to معذرة. لعل is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and the clause يتقون is its khabar; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿فكذبوه فأنجيناه والذين معه في الفلك﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), because it occurs as the apodosis of an omitted condition, i.e.: "If you wish to know the outcome of their affair: they denied him"; كذبوه is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فأنجيناه﴾ is conjoined to فكذبوه; the و is for accompaniment (maʿiyya), and الذين is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), or conjoined to the هاء; معه is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, i.e.: "who were settled with him in the ship", and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and في الفلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the (notion of) settledness that is in الملك [Translator's note: so in the source; probably a slip for الفلك or for the omitted ṣila], i.e. to what the adverb is attached to, or to أنجيناه.
﴿وأغرقنا الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; أغرقنا الذين is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause كذبوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذبوا.
﴿إنهم كانوا قوما عمين﴾: the clause gives the reason for their destruction mentioned before, i.e.: "they perished because of blindness in their inner sight"; إن is an abrogating particle, and the هاء is its noun (ism); ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), the و is its noun, and قومًا is its khabar (predicate); the clause كانوا is the khabar of إن; and عمين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قومًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:165-165.t:
﴿فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به﴾: The فاء is resumptive, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya). The clause نسوا has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation; نسوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ذكروا, built as a passive (for one whose agent is not named), has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; the واو is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذكروا.
﴿أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء﴾: The clause أنجينا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. الذي is the direct object, the clause ينهون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and عن السوء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينهون. The clause ﴿فلما نسوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source writes «الذي» for ﴿الذين﴾ here.]
﴿وأخذنا الذين ظلموا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿بعذاب بئيس بما كانوا يفسقون﴾: بعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخذنا, and بئيس is an adjective (naʿt) of عذاب. بما: the باء is a preposition of cause, i.e. «because of their transgression».

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿وإلى عاد أخاهم هودا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إلى عاد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb conjoined to أرسلنا; أخاهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أرسلنا; and هودًا is a corresponding badal (badal muṭābiq, substitute) from ﴿أخاهم﴾.
﴿قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله﴾: the conjunction has been omitted from ﴿قال﴾, unlike the first ayah in the story of Noah; يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; and the clause of vocative and command is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ما لكم من إله غيره﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; إله is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) in position; and غيره is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إله﴾ according to its position.
﴿أفلا تتقون﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, and the ف is for conjoining to an implied (clause), i.e.: "Do you not reflect?" or "Are you heedless, so that you do not fear (Allah)?"; لا is negating; تتقون is an imperfect verb in the nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; and the و is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:166-166.t: ﴿فلما عتوا عن ما نهوا عنه قلنا لهم كونوا قردة خاسئين﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya). عما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عتوا. The clause قلنا has no grammatical position, and the clause كونوا is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); قردة is the khabar (predicate) of كونوا, and خاسئين is an adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿قال الملأ الذين كفروا من قومه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذين is a naʿt (adjective); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and من قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إنا لنراك في سفاهة﴾: the clause of ﴿إن﴾ and what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of the chiefs; إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause نراك is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and في سفاهة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, or a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), considering the seeing to be mental (qalbiyya).
﴿وإنا لنظنك من الكاذبين﴾: conjoined to what preceded; إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the لام is the shifted lām; نظنك is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; and من الكاذبين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نظنك as its second object.

muyesser-irab:167-167.t:
﴿وإذ تأذن ربك﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb conjoined to ﴿واسألهم﴾, the implied form being «and remember the time when your Lord proclaimed». The clause ﴿تأذن﴾ is in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and ربك is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ليبعثن عليهم إلى يوم القيامة من يسومهم سوء العذاب﴾: The لام is the answer to the oath understood from the verb تأذن, and يبعثن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa. عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يبعثن or to تأذَّن. من is a relative noun, the object of يبعثن; the clause يسومهم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and سوء العذاب is the second direct object of يسومهم.
﴿إن ربك لسريع العقاب وإنه لغفور رحيم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ربك is its noun, and سريع العقاب is its khabar (predicate); the clause of إنّ with its noun and khabar is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. The clause وإنه لغفور رحيم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it, and the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿قال يا قوم ليس بي سفاهة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; the vocative clause and what follows it are the object of his saying; ﴿ليس﴾ is a defective past verb; بي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); and سفاهة is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿ولكني رسول من رب العالمين﴾: the و is circumstantial; لكن is an abrogating particle, the ياء is its noun, and رسول is its khabar; and من رب العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:168-168.t:
﴿وقطعناهم في الأرض أمما﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and قطعناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قطعناهم; أممًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a direct object; and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. [Translator's note: the source parses في الأرض twice, with two different attachments; translated as written.]
﴿منهم الصالحون ومنهم دون ذلك﴾: The clause is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿أممًا﴾. منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and الصالحون is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and دون is an adverb attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted qualified noun, which is the postponed mubtadaʾ. Similar to it is the saying of Allah the Exalted: [Translator's note: the source gives no verse here; what follows is the parsing of the next phrase of this ayah.] ﴿وبلوناهم بالحسنات والسيئات لعلهم يرجعون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and بلوناهم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قطعناهم; بالحسنات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بلوناهم, and السيئات is conjoined to الحسنات. لعل is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and the clause يرجعون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿أبلغكم رسالات ربي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, or the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of رسول; ﴿أبلغكم﴾ is a verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا); the كاف is the first object of أبلغكم, and رسالات ربي is its second object.
﴿وأنا لكم ناصح أمين﴾: the و is a conjunction; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ناصح; ناصح is the first khabar (predicate) of أنا, and أمين is the second khabar of أنا, or a naʿt of ناصح.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿أوعجبتم أن جاءكم ذكر من ربكم على رجل منكم لينذركم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, intended as a prohibition, i.e.: "Do not wonder, and reflect upon your affair"; the و is a conjunction; عجبتم is a past verb, the تاء is the fāʿil (agent), and the ميم is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿عجبتم﴾ is conjoined to an implied resumptive (clause) indicated by the context of the speech, i.e.: "Did you then deny and wonder?"; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن جاءكم﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عجبتم﴾, i.e.: "Do you wonder at the coming of a reminder from your Lord?"; ذِكْر is the fāʿil of جاءكم; من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ذِكْر; على رجل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿ذِكْر﴾, i.e.: "spoken on the tongue of a man"; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of رجل; ﴿لينذركم﴾: the لام is the lām of reason (taʿlīl), and ينذركم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the maṣdar is genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جاءكم.
﴿واذكروا إذ جعلكم خلفاء من بعد قوم نوح﴾: the و is a conjunction; اذكروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: "and remember the time when He made you"; and the clause is conjoined to an implied (clause), as though it were said: "Do not wonder", or "Reflect upon your affair, gain insight, and remember". The clause ﴿جعلكم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); جعلكم is a past verb, its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the كاف is the first mafʿūl bihi; خلفاء is the second object; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿خلفاء﴾; ﴿قوم﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi, and it is itself a muḍāf; and ﴿نوح﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وزادكم في الخلق بسطة﴾: conjoined to جعلكم; في الخلق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); بسطة is the second mafʿūl bihi of زادكم, or a tamyīz (specification); and the كاف is the first object.
﴿فاذكروا آلاء الله لعلكم تفلحون﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), because it occurs as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "If you have known this with true knowledge, reflected upon it, and gained insight into its outcomes and hidden aspects, then remember"; آلاء الله is a mafʿūl bihi; لعل is an abrogating particle, the كاف is its noun (ism), and the clause تفلحون is the khabar (predicate) of لعل; and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿قالوا أجئتنا لنعبد الله وحده ونذر ما كان يعبد آباؤنا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; جئتنا is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the لام is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); نعبد is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the لام; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئتنا; ﴿الله﴾ is its object; وحده is an interpreted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "alone"; نذر is an imperfect verb conjoined to نعبد; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; كان is a defective past verb, and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir); the clause يعبد آباؤنا is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كان; and the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); أتِ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); نا is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ائتنا﴾; the clause تعدنا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; كنت is a defective past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); كنت is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and the تاء is its noun; من الصادقين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of إن is omitted because what precedes indicates it, i.e.: "then bring us".

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿قال قد وقع عليكم من ربكم رجس وغضب﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); وقع is a past verb; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) وقع; رجس is the fāʿil (agent); من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رجس; غضب is conjoined to رجس; and the clause of قد and what falls within its scope is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿أتجادلونني في أسماء سميتموها أنتم وآباؤكم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; تجادلونني is an imperfect verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في أسماء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجادلونني; the clause سميتموها is a naʿt of أسماء; the و is for saturating (lengthening) the ḍamma; أنتم is a tawkīd (emphasis); and آباؤكم is conjoined to أنتم.
﴿ما نزل الله بها من سلطان﴾: the clause ما نزَّل is a second naʿt of أسماء; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نزل, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and سلطان is genitive in form and accusative in position as an object.
﴿فانتظروا إني معكم من المنتظرين﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); انتظروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; إن is an abrogating particle, and the ياء is its noun (ism); معكم is an adverb attached to المنتظرين; and من المنتظرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿فأنجيناه والذين معه برحمة منا﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e.: "So what happened happened, and We saved him"; أنجيناه is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذين is conjoined to the هاء in أنجيناه, or is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); معه is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; برحمة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنجيناه; and منّا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة.
﴿وقطعنا دابر الذين كذبوا بآياتنا وما كانوا مؤمنين﴾: the و is a conjunction; قطعنا is conjoined to أنجيناه; دابر is a mafʿūl bihi; الذين is a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause كذبوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ما كانوا is conjoined to كذبوا; and مؤمنين is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وإلى ثمود أخاهم صالحا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إلى ثمود is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb conjoined to أرسلنا; أخاهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أرسلنا; and صالحا is a corresponding badal (badal muṭābiq, substitute) from ﴿أخاهم﴾.
﴿قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; and the clause of vocative and command is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ما لكم من إله غيره﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; إله is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) in position; and غيره is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إله﴾ according to its position.
﴿قد جاءتكم بينة من ربكم﴾: the clause is included in the object of his saying; جاءتكم is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi; بينة is the fāʿil (agent); and من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءتكم, or to an omitted naʿt of بيّنة.
﴿هذه ناقة الله لكم آية﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ. ناقة is the khabar, and the Word of Majesty (Allah) is the muḍāf ilayhi. لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second khabar, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿آية﴾. آية is a ḥāl, and what governs it is the verbal sense indicated by the demonstrative. The clause ﴿هذه ناقة الله﴾ is in the position of nominative as a badal from ﴿بيِّنة﴾, because it serves as its explanation.
﴿فذروها تأكل في أرض الله﴾: the ف is consequential (tafrīʿiyya), because it comes as a consequence of her being one of the signs of Allah, which necessitates not touching her with harm; ذروها is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; تأكل is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request; and في أرض الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأكل, or to His saying فذروها, on the basis that it is a case of contention (tanāzuʿ, two governors competing for one word).
﴿ولا تمسوها بسوء فيأخذكم عذاب أليم﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تمسوها is an imperfect verb in the jussive, the و is the fāʿil, and ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; بسوء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تمسوها; ﴿فيأخذكم﴾: the ف is for causality (sababiyya), and يأخذكم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the ف, because it is the answer to the prohibition; the كاف is a mafʿūl bihi; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e.: "Let there be no touching of her on your part, and (so no) seizing of you by a punishment"; عذاب is the fāʿil, and أليم is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿واذكروا إذ جعلكم خلفاء من بعد عاد﴾: the و is a conjunction; اذكروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: "and remember the time when He made you"; the clause ﴿جعلكم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the كاف is the first mafʿūl bihi of جعلكم, and خلفاء is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿خلفاء﴾; and ﴿عاد﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وبوأكم في الأرض تتخذون من سهولها قصورا﴾: بوأكم is a verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بوأكم; the clause تتخذون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object; من سهولها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تتخذون, or to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿قصورًا﴾; and قصورًا is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وتنحتون الجبال بيوتا﴾: the و is a conjunction; تنحتون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; الجبال is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: "from the mountains"; and بيوتا is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara).
﴿فاذكروا آلاء الله ولا تعثوا في الأرض مفسدين﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); اذكروا is an imperative verb, and the و is the fāʿil; آلاء الله is a mafʿūl bihi; the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تعثوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تعثوا; and مفسدين is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿قال الملأ الذين استكبروا من قومه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذين is a relative noun in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective); the clause استكبروا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and من قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿للذين استضعفوا لمن آمن منهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال; the clause استضعفوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; لمن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted (element that is a) badal (substitute) from الذين استضعفوا; and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أتعلمون أن صالحا مرسل من ربه﴾: the hamza is for mocking interrogation, and the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); أن is an abrogating particle, صالحا is its noun (ism), and مرسل is its khabar (predicate); أن, its noun and its khabar stand in the place of the two objects of تعلمون; and من ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مرسل.
﴿قالوا إنا بما أرسل به مؤمنون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar ﴿مؤمنون﴾; the clause ﴿أرسل﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; إن and what follows it is a clause in the position of accusative as the object of the saying; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسل.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿قال الذين استكبروا﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; الذين is a relative noun and the fāʿil (agent); and the clause استكبروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنا بالذي آمنتم به كافرون﴾: the clause is the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿بالذي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) ﴿كافرون﴾; the clause ﴿آمنتم به﴾ is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; إن and what follows it is a clause in the position of accusative as the object of the saying; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنتم.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿فعقروا الناقة وعتوا عن أمر ربهم﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); عقروا الناقة is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عتوا is conjoined to عقروا; and عن أمر ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "being arrogant", or "acting on what insolence inspired in them".
﴿وقالوا يا صالح ائتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من المرسلين﴾: conjoined to what preceded; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil; يا is a vocative particle, and صالح is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the vocative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ائتنا is an imperative verb and a mafʿūl bihi; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ائتنا; the clause تعدنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional, and the omitted apodosis is indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "then bring us"; and من المرسلين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿فأخذتهم الرجفة فأصبحوا في دارهم جاثمين﴾: the ف is a conjunction; أخذتهم الرجفة is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); فأصبحوا is conjoined to فأخذتهم, and the و is the noun (ism) of أصبحوا; في دارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاثمين; and جاثمين is the khabar (predicate) of أصبحوا.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿فتولى عنهم وقال يا قوم﴾: the ف is a conjunction for immediate succession (taʿqīb); عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تولى; قال is conjoined to فتولى; يا is a vocative particle; and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted first-person ياء.
﴿لقد أبلغتكم رسالة ربي﴾: the لام is (in) the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); أبلغتكم is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and رسالة ربي is a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ونصحت لكم ولكن لا تحبون الناصحين﴾: conjoined to أبلغتكم; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نصحت; the و is circumstantial; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), lightened and inoperative (muhmal); لا is negating; and the clause لا تحبون الناصحين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it is a narration of a past state (ḥikāyat ḥāl māḍiya).

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿ولوطا إذ قال لقومه﴾: the و conjoins to the stories that preceded; لوطًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: "and remember Lot"; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from ﴿لوطًا﴾, i.e.: "and remember the time when he said to his people"; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and لقومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال.
﴿أتأتون الفاحشة﴾: the hamza is for disapproving, rebuking interrogation; تأتون الفاحشة is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e.: "Do you commit it, being the first to begin it?"; or from the mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: "Do you commit it, it being begun (by you), not preceded by others than you?" سبقكم is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سبقكم, or to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: "no one preceded you accompanied by it", i.e. engaged in it; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; أحد is the fāʿil of سبقكم; and من العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد.

muyesser-irab:169-169.t:
﴿فخلف من بعدهم خلف ورثوا الكتاب﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and خَلَف is a past verb; من بعدهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and خَلْف is the fāʿil (agent). The clause ورثوا الكتاب is an adjective (naʿt) of خلف.
﴿يأخذون عرض هذا الأدنى ويقولون سيغفر لنا﴾: The clause is a second adjective. عرض is the object of يأخذون, هذا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and الأدنى is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative.
﴿وإن يأتهم عرض مثله يأخذوه﴾: The واو is circumstantial, i.e. «while their state is that if there comes to them…»; or the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إن is conditional, يأتهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), عرض is the agent, and مثله is an adjective. يأخذوه is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the nūn.
﴿ألم يؤخذ عليهم ميثاق الكتاب﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī), لم is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, and يؤخذ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لم. عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤخذ, and ميثاق الكتاب is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿أن لا يقولوا على الله إلا الحق﴾: أن is maṣdarī, and together with what falls within its scope it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) whose position is the nominative as a badal of ميثاق, or the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The clause ﴿لا يقولوا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdarī ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) of ميثاق الكتاب, because it is in the sense of saying without its letters; ﴿لا﴾ is then prohibitive, and ﴿يقولوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive by ﴿لا﴾. On its being maṣdarī, ﴿لا﴾ is negating and the verb is in the accusative by the maṣdarī أن. ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقولوا, إلا is a particle of restriction, and الحق is the direct object, or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. «the true saying».
﴿ودرسوا ما فيه﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and درسوا is a past verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ألم يؤخذ عليهم﴾, as if it were said: «the covenant of the Book was taken from them, and they studied what is in it». ما is the object of درسوا, and فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿والدار الآخرة خير للذين يتقون﴾: The واو is resumptive or circumstantial. الدار is the mubtadaʾ (subject), الآخرة an adjective, and خير the khabar (predicate) of الدار; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير. The clause يتقون has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the accusative position as a ḥāl.
﴿أفلا تعقلون﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), the فاء is a conjunction coordinating with something omitted, لا is negating, and تعقلون is conjoined to this omitted [verb].

muyesser-irab:170-170.t:
﴿والذين يمسكون بالكتاب وأقاموا الصلاة﴾: The واو is resumptive, and الذين is a relative noun in the nominative position as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the khabar (predicate) is His saying ﴿إنا لا نضيع...﴾, and the linking pronoun (rābiṭ) is omitted because the meaning is understood, the implied form being «the reformers among them». Or the واو is a conjunction, and الذين is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿للذين يتقون﴾ in the previous ayah, in the genitive. يمسكون: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and بالكتاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يمسكون﴾; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause ﴿وأقاموا الصلاة﴾ – a verb, agent and object – is conjoined to the ṣila clause, and the clause ﴿والذين يمسكون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين﴾: The clause is the khabar of الذين, or resumptive, with no grammatical position. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, لا is negating, and the clause ﴿لا نضيع أجر المصلحين﴾ is the khabar of إنّ; the clause ﴿إنا لا نضيع...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:171-171.t:
﴿وإذ نتقنا الجبل فوقهم كأنه ظلة﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb conjoined to what preceded, its implied form being «remember». The clause ﴿نتقنا﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation; نتقنا is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its fāʿil (agent), and الجبل is the direct object. فوقهم is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [element] as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الجبل – and it is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), because it is the state of the raising – or it is attached to نتقنا. The clause كأنه ظلة is also a ḥāl of الجبل, so the ḥāl is multiple; [it consists of] كأنّ, its noun and its khabar (predicate).
﴿وظنوا أنه واقع بهم﴾: The clause is in the genitive position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause نتقنا, which is in the genitive by annexation; or the واو is circumstantial, with قد implied, and the one the ḥāl describes (ṣāḥib al-ḥāl) is the mountain; or the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. أنّ and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of ظن; أنّ is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, ﴿واقع﴾ is its khabar, and ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to واقع.
﴿خذوا ما آتيناكم بقوة﴾: The clause خذوا is in the accusative position as the object of an omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. «and We said to them: take». ما is a relative noun, the direct object; the clause آتيناكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and بقوة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. «resolved to bear its hardships».
﴿واذكروا ما فيه لعلكم تتقون﴾: Conjoined to what preceded. لعلكم: [لعل] an abrogating particle, the كاف is its noun, and the clause تتقون is its khabar; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:172-172.t:
﴿وإذ أخذ ربك من بني آدم من ظهورهم ذريتهم﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «remember». أخذ ربك is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and من بني آدم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخذ. من ظهورهم is a preposition and its genitive noun in the genitive position as a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from بني آدم, or a badal of part from whole (badal baʿḍ min kull) with the preposition repeated. ذريتهم is the direct object, and the clause ﴿أخذ ربك﴾ is in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وأشهدهم على أنفسهم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أشهدهم.
﴿ألست بربكم قالوا بلى﴾: The clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. «saying», and the clause of saying is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). The همزة is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī), the تاء is the noun of ليس, the باء is a redundant (ṣila) particle, and ربكم is genitive in form and the khabar (predicate) of ليس by position. The clause قالوا is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and بلى is a particle of answer for cancelling the negation and affirming what comes after the negative particle, i.e. the affirmation of lordship.
﴿شهدنا أن تقولوا يوم القيامة إنا كنا عن هذا غافلين﴾: شهدنا is a verb and its agent, and أن with what falls within its scope is in the accusative position as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). يوم القيامة: an adverb attached to تقولوا. The clause of إنّ and what falls within its scope is in the accusative position as the object of the saying; the clause كنا is the khabar of إنّ, غافلين is the khabar of كنا, and عن هذا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غافلين.

muyesser-irab:173-173.t:
﴿أو تقولوا إنما أشرك آباؤنا من قبل وكنا ذرية من بعدهم﴾: أو تقولوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أن تقولوا, and إنما is [إنّ] restrained and restraining (kāffa wa-makfūfa); the clause إنما أشرك آباؤنا is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of ذرية. [Translator's note: so in the source; it is presumably من بعدهم that is the adjective of ذرية, the parsing of من قبل having merged with it.]
﴿أفتهلكنا بما فعل المبطلون﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and the فاء is a conjunction. تهلكنا is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The باء is a preposition and denotes causation, ما is maṣdarī, and ﴿فعل المبطلون﴾ is a verb and its agent; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is in the genitive by the باء.

muyesser-irab:174-174.t: ﴿وكذلك نفصل الآيات ولعلهم يرجعون﴾: The واو is a conjunction. ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the accusative position as an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being «with a detailing like that We detail the signs». ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address. ﴿نفصل﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن», and ﴿الآيات﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ولعلهم﴾: the واو is a conjunction coordinating with something omitted, its implied form being «that they may reflect on them»; لعل is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and the clause ﴿يرجعون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:175-175.t:
﴿واتل عليهم نبأ الذي آتيناه آياتنا فانسلخ منها﴾: The واو is a conjunction coordinating with what ﴿إذ﴾ is attached to in His saying ﴿وإذ أخذ﴾. اتل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت», and عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اتل﴾. نبأ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الذي is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause آتيناه is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and آياتنا is a second direct object. فانسلخ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to آتيناه, and منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انسلخ.
﴿فأتبعه الشيطان فكان من الغاوين﴾: أتبع is a past verb, and الشيطان is the agent. ﴿فكان﴾ is conjoined to أتبعه, its noun is latent, and من الغاوين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:176-176.t:
﴿ولو شئنا لرفعناه بها﴾: The واو is circumstantial, and لو is conditional, non-jussive. شيئًا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). [Translator's note: the source writes «شيئًا» here, a misprint for ﴿شئنا﴾.] The لام is the answer of لو, the clause رفعناه has no grammatical position, and بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رفعناه.
﴿ولكنه أخلد إلى الأرض واتبع هواه﴾: The واو is a conjunction, لكنّ is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and the clause أخلد is the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ; إلى الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخلد.
﴿فمثله كمثل الكلب إن تحمل عليه يلهث أو تتركه يلهث﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, and مثله is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كمثل﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the nominative position as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and مَثَل is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿الكلب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إن﴾ is conditional, ﴿تحمل﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تحمل, and ﴿يلهث﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿تتركه﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), conjoined to the protasis, and ﴿يلهث﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive, conjoined to the apodosis.
﴿ذلك مثل القوم الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ, and مثل القوم is its khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). الذين is an adjective (naʿt) of القوم; the clause كذبوا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا.
﴿فاقصص القصص لعلهم يتفكرون﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, اقصص is an imperative verb, its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت», and القصص, in the sense of «what is narrated», is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause of hope is in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in ﴿اقصص﴾.

muyesser-irab:177-177.t:
﴿ساء مثلا القوم الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: ساء is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو»; مثلا is a tamyīz (specification) of the agent of ساء. The clause ﴿ساء﴾ is a fronted khabar (predicate), and القوم is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). Something omitted must be supplied so that the tamyīz, the agent and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) are all one in meaning, the implied form being: «evil as a likeness is the likeness of the people», or «evil are the people of the likeness of the people». الذين is an adjective (naʿt) of القوم, and the clause كذبوا بآياتنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأنفسهم كانوا يظلمون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and أنفسهم is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يظلمون; [كانوا] is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and the clause يظلمون is its khabar. What follows the conjunctive واو falls within the ṣila, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to كذبوا, in the sense of «those who combined denying the signs and wronging themselves»; or it is cut off from it, in the sense of «they wronged by the denial none but themselves». [Translator's note: the word كانوا is missing before «an incomplete, abrogating past verb» in the source.]

muyesser-irab:178-178.t:
﴿من يهد الله فهو المهتدي﴾: من is a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the accusative position as the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يهد, and الله is its fāʿil (agent). The فاء connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and المهتدي its khabar (predicate).
﴿ومن يضلل﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause.
﴿فأولئك هم الخاسرون﴾: The فاء is in the apodosis. أولئك is a demonstrative in the nominative position as the mubtadaʾ, هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) for emphasis, with no grammatical position, and الخاسرون is the khabar, in the nominative with the واو. The conditional clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the preceding one.

muyesser-irab:179-179.t:
﴿ولقد ذرأنا لجهنم كثيرا من الجن والإنس﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and the لام is the answer to the omitted oath. ذرأنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), لجهنم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذرأنا, كثيرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and من الجن والإنس is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾.
﴿لهم قلوب لا يفقهون بها ولهم أعين لا يبصرون بها ولهم آذان لا يسمعون بها﴾: لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and قلوب is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾, even though it is indefinite, because it is specified by the adjective. The clause لا يفقهون is an adjective of قلوب. The like of that is said of the two following clauses.
﴿أولئك كالأنعام بل هم أضل أولئك هم الغافلون﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿كالأنعام﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the nominative position as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and الأنعام is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction, هم is a mubtadaʾ, and أضل the khabar. أولئك is a mubtadaʾ, هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and الغافلون is the khabar of أولئك; or ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, الغافلون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause هم الغافلون is the khabar of أولئك.

nahhas-irab:47-47.t: They knew that He would not place them with them, so this is by way of self-abasement, just as the people of Paradise say: رَبَّنا أَتْمِمْ لَنا نُورَنا ["Our Lord, perfect for us our light"; al-Taḥrīm: 8], and they say «الحمد لله» ("Praise be to Allah") by way of gratitude to Allah, Mighty and Exalted, and they find delight in that.

nahhas-irab:48-48.t: That is, from among the people of the Fire.

nahhas-irab:49-49.t: أَهؤُلاءِ is a pointing to the believing people whom you swore Allah would not reach with mercy; that is, you swore in this world that Allah would not reach them in the Hereafter with mercy. They rebuke them with that, and their grief was increased by its being said to them: ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ. ʿIkrima read دخلوا الجنة without the alif, with the dāl vowelled with fatḥa, and Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif read أدخلوا الجنة with kasra on the khāʾ, taking it as a past verb.

nahhas-irab:50-50.t: أَنْ أَفِيضُوا عَلَيْنا مِنَ الْماءِ is like «أن تلكم الجنّة». The plural of تِلْقاءَ is تلاقيّ.

nahhas-irab:51-51.t: الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَهْواً وَلَعِباً is in the position of the genitive (khafḍ), a naʿt (adjective) of «الكافرين»; it may also be nominative or accusative by an implied (muḍmar) word. كَما نَسُوا is in the position of the genitive by the kāf. وَما كانُوا بِآياتِنا يَجْحَدُونَ is conjoined to it, i.e. "and as they used to deny Our signs".

nahhas-irab:52-52.t: وَلَقَدْ جِئْناهُمْ بِكِتابٍ فَصَّلْناهُ: that is, We made it clear so that whoever reflects on it may know it; and it was said: فصّلناه means "We sent it down in separate parts". عَلى عِلْمٍ: "on Our part, of it". هُدىً وَرَحْمَةً: al-Farrāʾ said it is accusative by qaṭʿ ("severance"). Abū Isḥāq said: that is, "guiding, possessing mercy", so he made it a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «فصّلناه». Al-Kisāʾī and al-Farrāʾ said: هُدىً وَرَحْمَةً in the genitive is also permissible. Al-Farrāʾ said: it is like وَهذا كِتابٌ أَنْزَلْناهُ مُبارَكٌ [al-Anʿām: 92]. Abū Isḥāq said: «هدى ورحمة» is also permissible [in the nominative] in the sense of "it is guidance and mercy".

nahhas-irab:53-53.t:
هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا تَأْوِيلَهُ is with hamza, because it is from آل يؤول; the people of Medina lighten the hamza and make it an alif. There are two views on its meaning: one of them is "do they await anything but what they were promised in the Qurʾān of punishment and reckoning", and the other view is "do they await anything but its tawīl", from looking toward the Day of Resurrection. يَوْمَ يَأْتِي is accusative by «يقول». فَهَلْ لَنا مِنْ شُفَعاءَ: «من» is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis. فَيَشْفَعُوا لَنا is accusative because it is the answer to the interrogative. أَوْ نُرَدُّ: al-Farrāʾ said: the meaning is "or will we be returned?", and Abū Isḥāq said: it is conjoined to the sense, i.e. "will anyone intercede for us, or will we be returned?". Ibn Abī Isḥāq read أَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ with both of them in the accusative, the meaning being "unless we are returned", as Imruʾ al-Qays said: [al-Ṭawīl] 148-
فقلت له لا تبك عينك إنّما ... نحاول ملكا أو نموت فنعذرا
(I said to him: let your eye not weep; we are only seeking a kingdom, or else we die and are excused.)
Al-Ḥasan read أَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ with both of them in the nominative, and the reading agreed upon is أَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ. قَدْ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ: that is, they did not benefit from them, and whoever does not benefit from something has lost it.
وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ما كانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ: what they used to worship of idols.

nahhas-irab:54-54.t:
إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ is the noun of «إنّ», (اللَّهُ) is its khabar (predicate). الَّذِي is a naʿt (adjective); and it is permissible in the Qurʾān [i.e. in such a structure] — إن ربّكم الله الذي — for «الذي» to be the khabar. خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ: had He, Mighty and Exalted, willed to create them in the shortest of times, He would have done so, but He knew that this was more fitting, so as to show His power to the angels one thing after another.
يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهارَ: that is, He makes it like a covering for it; it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and it may be resumptive; and likewise يَطْلُبُهُ. حَثِيثاً is a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun). وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّراتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ: al-Akhfash said: they are conjoined to «السموات», i.e. "and He created the sun". It is related from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir: وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّراتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ as mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). [Translator's note: the Quranic words are printed with the standard accusative vocalisation although the reading described is in the nominative.]

nahhas-irab:56-56.t:
[Translator's note: the opening words of this entry appear garbled in the source; the ayah discussed is إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ.] The noun of «إنّ» and its khabar «فأما قريب», and He did not say «قريبا» [sic; i.e. «قريبة»]; there are six views on this. Among the best of them is that al-raḥma and al-ruḥm are one and the same, and it means pardon and forgiveness, as Ziyād al-Aʿjam said: [al-Kāmil] 149-
إنّ السّماحة والمروءة ضمّنا ... قبرا بمرو على الطّريق الواضح
(Generosity and manly virtue have been enclosed in a grave at Marw, on the clear road.)
The view of al-Farrāʾ is that قريبا came without the hāʾ only to distinguish between "near" in kinship and this; and one who argued for him said: such is the speech of the Arabs, as Imruʾ al-Qays said: [al-Ṭawīl] 150-
له الويل إن أمسى ولا أمّ هاشم ... قريب ولا بسباسة ابنة يشكرا
(Woe to him if he passes the evening with neither Umm Hāshim near, nor Basbāsa daughter of Yashkur.)
Abū Isḥāq said: this is a mistake, because the way of the masculine and the feminine is that they follow their verbs. The view of Abū ʿUbayda is that قريب is masculine on account of the masculinity of "place". ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān said: this is a mistake; had it been as he said, قريب would have been accusative in the Qurʾān, as you say: إنّ زيدا قريبا منك.
Abū Jaʿfar said: Sībawayh permitted something like what Abū ʿUbayda said, as a remote possibility, as Labīd said:
[al-Kāmil] 151-
فغدت كلا الفرجين تحسب أنّه ... مولى المخافة خلفها وأمامها
(She set off in the morning thinking that each of the two openings — behind her and in front of her — was the place of fear.)
These are three views. Al-Akhfash said: it may be made masculine just as some feminines are made masculine, and he recited: [al-Mutaqārib] 152-
فلا مزنة ودقت ودقها ... ولا أرض أبقل إبقالها
(No rain-cloud has poured down like its pouring, and no land has put forth herbage like its putting forth.)
He said: and it is possible that "mercy" here means rain. The sixth view is that this is by way of attribution (nasab), as one says: امرأة طالق ("a divorced woman") and حائض ("a menstruating woman"). [Translator's note: the source counts "six views" but the enumeration as printed is not fully explicit.]

nahhas-irab:57-57.t: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّياحَ is mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). الرياح is the plural of ريح for a larger number, and for a smaller number أرواح, because the yāʾ in ريح is changed from a wāw since a kasra precedes it and it is unvowelled. بُشْراً بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ: there are six readings of it, and a seventh which is permissible. The people of the two Sanctuaries and Abū ʿAmr read نُشُراً with ḍamma on the nūn and the shīn; al-Ḥasan and Qatāda read نُشْراً with ḍamma on the nūn and the shīn unvowelled; al-Aʿmash, Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read نَشْراً with fatḥa on the nūn and the shīn unvowelled; ʿĀṣim read بُشْراً with the bāʾ, the shīn unvowelled and with tanwīn, and it is related from him بُشْراً with fatḥa on the bāʾ. These are five readings. Muḥammad al-Yamānī read بشرى بين يدي رحمته on the pattern of حبلى, and the seventh reading is بشرا with ḍamma on the bāʾ and the shīn. Abū Jaʿfar said: we have mentioned their meanings in our book al-Maʿānī. It is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and whichever of them is a maṣdar (verbal noun) is like the saying «قتلته صبرا» ("I killed him in confinement"). حَتَّى إِذا أَقَلَّتْ سَحاباً: it [سحاب] is treated as masculine and feminine, and likewise every plural between which and its singular there is a hāʾ; and it may be described with a singular, so you say: سحاب ثقيل and ثقيلة. سُقْناهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ: «لبلد» and «إلى بلد» have one meaning. كَذلِكَ: the kāf is in the position of the accusative.

nahhas-irab:58-58.t:
وَالْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ is nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). يَخْرُجُ نَباتُهُ is in the position of the khabar (predicate). ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar read يخرج نباته بإذن ربه with ḍamma on the yāʾ. وَالْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ is the one whose soil is good, and the one that is bad is the one in whose soil there are stones and in whose ground there are thorns; the one quick of understanding is likened to the good land. And the land that is bad, لا يَخْرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِداً: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Ṭalḥa read إِلَّا نَكِداً [i.e. نَكْدا], dropping the kasra because of its heaviness; it may be a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of "possessing scantiness". Abū Jaʿfar read إِلَّا نَكِداً [i.e. نَكَدا]; this is a maṣdar in the sense of "possessing scantiness", as al-Khansāʾ said: [al-Basīṭ] 153-
فإنّما هي إقبال وإدبار
(For she is but coming and going.)

nahhas-irab:59-59.t:
لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنا نُوحاً إِلى قَوْمِهِ فَقالَ يا قَوْمِ: the fāʾ indicates that the second comes after the first. يا قَوْمِ is a vocative in construct (muḍāf); يا قومي is also permissible, on the original form. اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ ما لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلهٍ غَيْرُهُ: this is the reading of Abū ʿAmr, Shayba, Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim and Ḥamza. Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb, al-Aʿmash, al-Kisāʾī and Abū Jaʿfar read غيره in the genitive, and it is the choice of Abū ʿUbayd. Abū ʿAmr said: I do not know the genitive or the accusative. ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar said: the accusative and the genitive are both permissible. Abū Jaʿfar said: the nominative is from two angles. One of them is that «غير» stands in the place of «إلّا», so you say ما لكم إله إلّا الله and ما لكم إله غير الله; on this view the genitive is not permissible, [just as] ما جاءني من أحد إلّا زيد is not permissible, because «من» only occurs in a negative (non-affirmative) context [lit. "is not in the affirmative"]. Sībawayh said: because «على» and «عن» are not treated thus — i.e. they are never redundant at all — then he said: nor «من» in the affirmative. The other angle of the nominative is that it is a naʿt (adjective) on the position, i.e. ما لكم إله غيره, and the genitive is on the wording. The accusative as exception is also permissible, but it is not frequent, except that al-Kisāʾī and al-Farrāʾ permitted the accusative of «غير» in every place where «إلّا» would fit in its position, whether the sentence is complete or not, and they permitted ما جاءني غيرك. Al-Farrāʾ said: it is the dialect of some of Banū Asad and Quḍāʿa, and he recited: [al-Basīṭ] 154-
لم يمنع الشّرب منها غير أن هتفت ... حمامة في سحوق ذات أو قال
(Nothing kept her from drinking but that a dove cooed on a tall palm-tree laden with clusters.)
Al-Kisāʾī said: جاءني غيرك [in the accusative] is not permissible, because «إلّا» does not occur here. Abū Jaʿfar said: according to the Basrans the accusative of غير is not permissible when the sentence is not complete, and that is, in their view, among the ugliest of solecisms. Abū Isḥāq said: what led him astray — meaning al-Farrāʾ — was only the verse which Sībawayh recited with it in the accusative; غير is accusative in the verse only because it is annexed to something that has no inflection. As for ما جاءني غيرك [in the accusative], it is a solecism and an error.

nahhas-irab:62-62.t:
أُبَلِّغُكُمْ and أبلّغكم are one, as is said أكرمه and كرّمه, and as he said: [al-Ṭawīl] 155-
ومن لا يكرم نفسه لا يكرم
(And whoever does not honour himself is not honoured.)
[Translator's note: the two forms are printed identically in the source; the intended pair is أُبْلِغُكُم / أُبَلِّغُكُم.]

nahhas-irab:63-63.t: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ: the wāw is vowelled with fatḥa because it is a conjunctive wāw upon which the interrogative alif has entered for affirmation (taqrīr). The way of the wāw is to enter upon the interrogative particles, except the alif, because of its strength.

nahhas-irab:65-65.t: وَإِلى عادٍ: if you wish you may make it a diptote, it being a name of the tribe, as He, Mighty and Exalted, said: وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عاداً الْأُولى [al-Najm: 50]; and whoever declines it fully makes it a name of the clan (ḥayy). أَخاهُمْ is conjoined, and it is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the implied structure is "And to ʿĀd We sent their brother". هُوداً is a badal (substitute); it is declined although it is foreign, because of its lightness, since it is of three letters; it may also be Arabic, derived from هاد يهود.

nahhas-irab:67-67.t: لَيْسَ بِي سَفاهَةٌ: had it been ليست it would have been permissible; the masculine is because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) and something separates it from the verb.

nahhas-irab:69-69.t:
خُلَفاءَ is the plural of خليفة treated as masculine according to the meaning, and خلائف [is its plural] according to the wording. وَزادَكُمْ فِي الْخَلْقِ بَصْطَةً: al-Farrāʾ said: it is related that the tallest of them was a hundred cubits and the shortest of them sixty cubits.
بَصْطَةً with ṣād is permissible because a ṭāʾ comes after it.

nahhas-irab:71-71.t: قالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَغَضَبٌ أَتُجادِلُونَنِي فِي أَسْماءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوها أَنْتُمْ وَآباؤُكُمْ ما نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ بِها مِنْ سُلْطانٍ فَانْتَظِرُوا إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ (71) فِي أَسْماءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوها: the second object is omitted, i.e. "you named them gods".

nahhas-irab:73-73.t: وَإِلى ثَمُودَ is a diptote because it is made a name of the tribe. Abū Ḥātim said: it is a diptote because it is foreign; this is an error, because it is derived from al-thamad (scanty water). Al-Farrāʾ read أَلا إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ [Hūd: 68] taking it as a name of the clan, and Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb read وَإِلى ثَمُودَ أَخاهُمْ صالِحاً fully declined.

nahhas-irab:74-74.t: Al-Ḥasan read وَتَنْحِتُونَ الْجِبالَ with fatḥa on the ḥāʾ; it is a dialect form, and there is in it one of the guttural letters, so it came on the pattern faʿala yafʿalu. Al-Aʿmash read ولا تعثوا with kasra on the tāʾ, taking it from عثي يعثى, not from عثا يعثو.

nahhas-irab:80-81.t: وَلُوطاً is accusative because it is conjoined, i.e. "and We sent Lūṭ"; it may also be accusative in the sense of "and remember", and likewise what preceded of its like, except that al-Farrāʾ permitted «وإلى عاد أخوهم هود» [in the nominative] because it has something to make it nominative, while in his view this is not permissible for Lūṭ. Abū Isḥāq said: one of the grammarians — meaning al-Farrāʾ — claimed that لوط may be derived from لطت الحوض ("I plastered the cistern"). He said: this is a mistake, because foreign names are not derived. أَتَأْتُونَ الْفاحِشَةَ is an interrogative carrying the sense of affirmation (taqrīr). The readers differed over what follows it. Abū ʿAmr read it as an interrogative, except that he softened the hamza, making it between hamza and yāʾ; ʿĀṣim and Ḥamza also read it as an interrogative, but they pronounced the hamza fully, reading أانكم; al-Kisāʾī and Nāfiʿ read the second without hamza, and it is the choice of Abū ʿUbayd. He and al-Kisāʾī both argued from His saying, Mighty and Exalted: أَفَإِنْ مِتَّ فَهُمُ الْخالِدُونَ [al-Anbiyāʾ: 34], where He did not say أفهم, and from His saying: أَفَإِنْ ماتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ انْقَلَبْتُمْ [Āl ʿImrān: 144], where He did not say أانقلبتم [the source prints: انقلبتم]. Abū Jaʿfar said: it is related of Muḥammad ibn Yazīd that he inclined to the view of Abū ʿUbayd and al-Kisāʾī, and this is among the ugliest of errors, because they likened two things to something they do not resemble: the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of a single thing, so there cannot be two interrogatives in them, like the mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); thus أفإن متّ أفهم الخالدون is not permissible, just as أزيد أمنطلق is not permissible. The story of Lūṭ ﷺ contains two sentences, so you may ask a question about each one of them, and omission from the second is permissible because the first indicates it; but the preferred choice is to lighten the second hamza, and this is the view of al-Khalīl and Sībawayh. بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُسْرِفُونَ is mubtadaʾ and khabar.

nahhas-irab:82-82.t: وَما كانَ جَوابَ قَوْمِهِ: the khabar (predicate) is أَنْ قالُوا. If you make [جواب] accusative, then the noun [of كان] is «أن قالوا», i.e. "except their saying". [Translator's note: as printed, the first clause presupposes the nominative جوابُ; the Quranic text has the accusative جوابَ, which is what the second clause explains.]

nahhas-irab:83-83.t: فَأَنْجَيْناهُ وَأَهْلَهُ is conjoined to the hāʾ. إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ is an exception from an affirmative statement.

nahhas-irab:85-85.t: وَإِلى مَدْيَنَ is a diptote because it is the name of a city; it was also said: because it is the name of a tribe, and it was said: because of foreignness; the soundest is the first. أَخاهُمْ is conjoined. فَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ is from أوفى; one also says وفى, and in that dialect [it would be] فأوفوا [i.e. فَفُوا]. [Translator's note: the dialect form is printed as فأوفوا in the source.]

nahhas-irab:86-86.t: Al-Akhfash said: وَلا تَقْعُدُوا بِكُلِّ صِراطٍ means "on every path"; "So-and-so is بالبصرة" and "في البصرة" are one. تُوعِدُونَ وَتَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ: i.e. from the road that leads to obedience to Allah, Mighty and Exalted. وَتَبْغُونَها عِوَجاً: two objects, the implied structure being "they seek for it crookedness". One says: in religion and in a matter there is عِوَج, and in a stick there is عَوَج.

nahhas-irab:87-87.t: وَإِنْ كانَ طائِفَةٌ: masculine according to the meaning; according to the wording [it would be] كانت.

nahhas-irab:89-89.t: وَما يَكُونُ لَنا أَنْ نَعُودَ «فيها» is the noun of يكون. إِلَّا أَنْ يَشاءَ اللَّهُ is in the position of the accusative, and there are two construals of it. Abū Isḥāq said: i.e. "except by the will of Allah, Mighty and Exalted". He said: and this is the view of the people of the Sunna. The other construal is that it is an exception not of the same kind as the first, and there are two views on its meaning: one of them is "unless Allah wills to make us worship Him by something of what you follow", and the other view is that it is like حَتَّى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِياطِ [al-Aʿrāf: 40]. [Translator's note: "«فيها» is the noun of يكون" is as printed; the noun of يكون is the interpreted maṣdar أن نعود.]

nahhas-irab:93-93.t: Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb, al-Aʿmash and Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif read فكيف إيس على قوم كافرين; this is the dialect of Tamīm, who say: أنا اضرب [i.e. with kasra on the prefix of the imperfect]. [Translator's note: the reading is presumably إيسى, with kasra on the prefix; it is printed as إيس.]

nahhas-irab:97-98.t: أَفَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرى is like أوعجبتم, and likewise أَوَأَمِنَ in this reading. Two forms are related from Nāfiʿ: Qālūn and most people related from him that he read أَوَأَمِنَ with the wāw unvowelled, and Warsh related from him أومن with the wāw vowelled and the hamza dropped. The two forms go back to one meaning, because he cast the vowel of the hamza onto the wāw when he wanted to lighten it and drop it. The meaning of «أو» here is passing from one thing to another, and its like is His saying, Mighty and Exalted: إِنْ يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِنْ يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ [al-Isrāʾ: 54].

nahhas-irab:100-100.t: The people of the two Sanctuaries and Abū ʿAmr read أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْأَرْضَ with the yāʾ, so «أن» is in the position of the nominative on this reading. Mujāhid and Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān read with the nūn: أولم نهد. Abū ʿAmr said: the reading with the nūn is impossible. Abū Jaʿfar said: «أن» is in the position of the accusative on the reading of whoever read with the nūn, in the sense of "because We struck them for some of their sins", and the sentence is complete; then He, Mighty and Exalted, said: [وَنَطْبَعُ] عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ [لا يَسْمَعُونَ]. It [نطبع] cannot be conjoined to «أصبناهم», because أصبناهم is past and نطبع is future; al-Farrāʾ permitted the conjunction, because the future and the past occur here with one meaning.

nahhas-irab:101-101.t: فَما كانُوا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِما كَذَّبُوا مِنْ قَبْلُ: al-Akhfash said: i.e. "it was not that they would be judged to have faith, given their denial", i.e. they are not believers given their denial. Others said: this concerns particular people. كَذلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلى قُلُوبِ الْكافِرِينَ: [the kāf] is in the position of the accusative.

nahhas-irab:102-102.t: وَما وَجَدْنا لِأَكْثَرِهِمْ مِنْ عَهْدٍ is in the position of the accusative, the meaning being "We did not find for most of them a covenant"; «من» is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis. There are two views on it: one is that the meaning is "We did not find in most of them fidelity to the covenant", i.e. fidelity to a covenant — i.e. when a covenant was made with them they did not fulfil it. The second view is that «العهد» means obedience, because obedience is incumbent on a person just as fidelity to the covenant is incumbent on him. وَإِنْ وَجَدْنا أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفاسِقِينَ: al-Farrāʾ says: the meaning is "We found most of them only defiantly disobedient", and Sībawayh holds that this «إن» is the heavy one, lightened, and the lām is then required.

nahhas-irab:105-105.t:
حَقِيقٌ عَلى أَنْ لا أَقُولَ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا: this is the reading of Nāfiʿ and Shayba [i.e. عَلَيَّ]. Abū Jaʿfar, Abū ʿAmr, the people of Mecca and the people of Kufa read (على ألّا) lightened, in the sense of "worthy" and "apt"; one says: فلان خليق بأن يفعل, جدير أن يفعل, and على أن يفعل, with one meaning. The meaning of «حقيق عليّ» is "incumbent on me", and «أن» on this reading is in the position of the nominative. In the written text (al-sawād) it is joined in one place and separate in another place. The grammarians have discussed this. Al-Mulham, the companion of al-Akhfash Saʿīd ibn Masʿada, said: among the Arabs are those who assimilate with nasalisation (ghunna) and those who assimilate without nasalisation; whoever assimilates with nasalisation writes it separate, and whoever assimilates without nasalisation writes it joined, because he has removed the nūn and the nasalisation in it. Al-Qutabī said: whoever makes it govern the accusative writes it joined, and whoever does not make it govern the accusative writes it separate, as in أَفَلا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا [Ṭāhā: 89]; this is separate because there is an implied element (iḍmār) in it. Abū Jaʿfar said:
And I heard Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān say: none of this may be written except separate, because it is «أن» upon which «لا» has entered.

nahhas-irab:107-107.t: فَأَلْقى عَصاهُ فَإِذا هِيَ: the wāw was dropped because it is unvowelled and the alif is unvowelled; فألقى عصا هو فإذا هي is also permissible, with the wāw [pronounced] — the hāʾ being between two unvowelled letters.
